title: 第4736章 救山羊第4735章 找到山羊
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九阳武神第4736章救山羊（..la）这个时候，那些生灵将老牛和山羊都团团包围了起来。
山羊和老牛现在底气十足，因为叶云飞就在附近。
特别是老牛，之前可是亲眼看着叶云飞轻松就灭掉了两个开天神。
而此时混老已经利用空间秘术，将周围的空间全部都控制住。
“现在只要我心念一动，这些家伙就全部都要受到这里空间的镇压。”
混老说道。
“等等，我先布置一些阵法和地阵，将这里彻底围困起来，这些家伙一个也不能让他们逃掉。”
叶云飞想了想说道。
然后叶云飞开始悄悄在周围的空间之中布置阵法以及地阵。不久之后一大批阵法和地阵被布置出来。
加上混老所施展的那些空间秘术，这一片空间已经彻底被混老和叶云飞两个控制住了。
“事不宜迟，现在开始动手吧。这些家伙逃不掉的了。”
混老对叶云飞传音说道。
“那好，马上将他们困住，然后我来动手对付他们。”
叶云飞看到那些生灵还在不断地围攻山羊和老牛，马上就向混老传音说道。
混老收到叶云飞的传音之后，马上就开始让周围的空间不断地扭曲变形，叶云飞所布置的那些阵法和地阵也开始悄悄地浮现。
顿时，这一片空间就彻底被围困住了，扭曲变形的空间顿时就让所有的混沌神都无法动弹，还有几个开天神也行动艰难。
叶云飞首先对那些混沌神动手，一个又一个混沌神不断遭到叶云飞施展的魂术和心力武技的攻击，开始发出惨叫声。
他们的躯体已经被扭曲的空间死死地镇压在那里，无法动弹，只能拼命地调动魂海中的魂力能量以及魂力类法宝进行反抗。
可是根本就没有用，单单是叶云飞所施展的一念成真就已经让这些混沌神无法应付。
叶云飞现在施展一念成真秘术，所凝聚出来的那些心力匕首极难防御，而且威力强大，片刻间就将这些混沌神的灵魂体完全镇压住，彻底失去了反抗之力。

然后叶云飞将这些混沌神的灵魂体吞噬掉，又或者收为分身。其中有三个是开天神，而且都是第一重开天神。
这三个开天神的躯体被扭曲变形的空间团团围困住，无法动弹。他们知道情况很不妙，拼命挣扎，想要离开这里，但是根本就做不到。
“混老，现在你面对第一重开天神已经有了完全碾压的实力。”
叶云飞看到那三个第一重开天神被混老所施展的空间秘术死死地镇压在那里，不由得赞叹说道。
“普通的第一重开天神的确很难破解我的空间秘术了。”
混老点了点头。
片刻之后，叶云飞就将所有的混沌神都解决掉。
这些混沌神有的变成了叶云飞的分身，有的灵魂体被叶云飞吞噬掉，彻底陨落。
“该死的，到底是谁？给我滚出来！”
那三个开天神知道肯定有强者躲在一旁对他们出手，但是由于他们周围的空间已经被混老所施展的秘术进行隔绝，所以他们根本就感知不到混老和叶云飞的存在。
“这好像不是叶公子的手段，而是他身旁那棵树的手段。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Nine Yang Martial God Chapter 4736 Saving the Goat (..la) At this time, those creatures surrounded the old cow and the goat.
The goat and the old cow are now confident because Ye Yunfei is nearby.
Especially Lao Niu, he had watched Ye Yunfei kill two Kaitian Gods with ease before.
At this time, Hun Lao had already used the secret technique of space to control all the surrounding space.
"Now as long as I have a thought, all these guys will be suppressed by this space."
The old man said.
"Wait a minute, I'll set up some formations and ground formations first to completely surround this place. None of these guys can let them escape."
Ye Yunfei thought for a while and said.
Then Ye Yunfei began to quietly arrange formations and ground formations in the surrounding space. Soon after, a large number of formations and ground formations were deployed.
Coupled with the secret space techniques used by Mr. Hun, this space has been completely controlled by Mr. Hun and Ye Yunfei.
"Without further ado, let's start taking action now. These guys can't escape."
Mr. Hun said to Ye Yunfei through a message.
"Okay, trap them immediately, and then I'll deal with them."
Ye Yunfei saw that those creatures were still besieging the goat and the old cow, and immediately sent a message to Mr. Hun.
After Hun Lao received Ye Yunfei's message, he immediately began to distort and deform the surrounding space, and the formations and ground formations arranged by Ye Yunfei also began to quietly emerge.
Immediately, this space was completely surrounded, and the distorted space immediately made it impossible for all the Chaos Gods to move, and several Kaitian Gods also had difficulty moving.
Ye Yunfei was the first to attack the Chaos Gods. One after another, the Chaos Gods were continuously attacked by Ye Yunfei's soul skills and mental martial arts, and began to scream in agony.
Their bodies have been suppressed there by the twisted space, unable to move, and they can only desperately mobilize the soul energy and soul magic weapons in the soul sea to resist.
But it was of no use at all. Just the thought coming true performed by Ye Yunfei was already too much for these Chaos Gods to deal with.
Ye Yunfei is now using the secret technique of making one thought come true. The daggers of his concentrated mind are extremely difficult to defend against and are powerful. In an instant, they completely suppress the souls of these Chaos Gods, completely losing their ability to resist.
Then Ye Yunfei swallowed the souls of these chaos gods, or took them into clones. Three of them are open gods, and they are all the first level open gods.
The bodies of these three Kaitian gods were surrounded by the twisted and deformed space, unable to move. They knew the situation was bad and struggled desperately to get out of here, but they couldn't do it.
"Hun Lao, now you have the power to completely crush the first re-opening god."
Ye Yunfei couldn't help but admired when he saw the three first re-opening gods being suppressed by the space secret technique used by Mr. Hun.
"It is really difficult for ordinary first-level gods to decipher my space secrets."
The old man nodded.
After a while, Ye Yunfei eliminated all the Chaos Gods.
Some of these Chaos Gods became Ye Yunfei's clones, and some souls were devoured by Ye Yunfei and perished completely.
"Damn it, who is it? Get out of here!"
The three Kaitian gods knew that there must be strong men hiding aside to attack them, but because the space around them had been isolated by the secret technique used by Mr. Hun, they could not sense the existence of Mr. Hun and Ye Yunfei at all.
"It seems that this is not Mr. Ye's method, but the method of the tree next to him."
